title: Evaluation when no term is compatible
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction. If no term of $\varphi$ can evaluate to $-1$ on any sign vector completing $\rho$, then for every $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, $\varphi$ evaluates to $1$ on the completion of $\rho$ specified by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
